main_text.p: nones qui dicuntur Apostolorum, seu quia eos dem nec sedes Apostolica recepit,nec sanǝti pa tres illis assensum præbueruit, pro eo quod ab hæreticis sub nomine Apostolorum compositi dignoscuntur , quamuis in eis vtilia inuenian- tur,tamen ab authoritate Canonica atque Apo stolica eorum gefta constat esse remota, atque inter Apocrypha deputata.
Zepherinus Papa,mox 60. ex eis sententias recipiendas dicit, Leo,omnes, exceptis quin- quaginta.
Dist. 32. C. Præter.) dicitur,quôd Canoni- bus Apostolorum Orientalis, & ex parte tan- tum Romana vtatur ecclefia.
main_text.head: DE CONCILIIS.
CAPVT IIII.

p.i: Concilia quædam in ipsis Decretis dam- nata.

main_text.p: Dist.15.C. Sancta Romana.)Imprimis Ari- minensem synodum à Constätino Cæsare Co stantini filio congregatam, mediante Tauro præfecto,ex tunc & in æternum confitemur es se damnatam.

page.notes: The Latin text is printed in a roman face with long s; "s" appears as a long s in the source, and the abbreviation "Co stantini" is a printed line-break split. The line "Co" before "stantini" is printed as "Cô" with a tilde-like mark over the o, kept as printed. The line "Concilia quomodo Concilianda. Isidori." and "Dist." are set in italic and right-aligned. The "nones" at the top is a fragment that continues from the previous page. Some faint show-through from the reverse side is present in the right margin and is not transcribed.
